metadata.recommended_source: TUM RGB-D freiburg1_room — full room-LOOP gate scene (1362 frames). Fails the band gate (occ_iou~0) for the same depth-limited obstacle-base miss as every scene. NOTE: at the staged 13-keyframe recipe the scorecard looks catastrophic (cam RMSE 0.82m, scale 0.28, coverage 0.019) but that is keyframe UNDER-SAMPLING, not loop-closure: at ~48 keyframes the loop reconstructs near-metric (cam RMSE 0.24-0.46m, coverage 0.58, scale ~0.9), better-posed than desk. The fixed keyframe budget under-samples long trajectories; a motion-aware adaptive selector is the real fix. See docs/band_obstacle_recall_evidence.md Phase 5. Shares fr1 intrinsics.
